note: FABRICATED test data for P8-42c2 (canary ZQ42C2). No figure, number, name or address here belongs to anyone; every program, member, member number and balance is invented. Written by the orchestrator at G0 from scratchpad gen_read_fixtures.py and pinned by SHA-256 in command 16; the implementer never edits it.

conventions.dayTokens: {{DAY:n}} means (CURRENT_DATE + n)::text from Postgres; replace before use. Offsets in asOfOffset/receivedOffset are the same n.
conventions.readerOutput: decisions[].reader and clean[].input are the RAW object a fake reader returns (the model schema, before the clean pass).
conventions.cleanResult: clean[].expect is the cleaned object {programName, suffix, balance, unit, asOf, expiryWarnings, instruments}. programName is the program-check form (lower-cased, non-alphanumerics removed; null when absent, when it holds '<' or '>', or when the result is empty or longer than 60). It is used only for the program check and never stored. An expiry amount is parsed with the warning's kind as the unit; for status and other it is always null; an unparseable amount is null and the warning is kept. A warning without a valid kind or date is dropped; an instrument without a valid kind is dropped, and an invalid expiry becomes null. Arrays are truncated to their caps in order.
conventions.decisionExpect: membership is a memberships[].id or null; balanceAfter is that membership's current balance after the read (null when no membership); observation says whether one loyalty_observations row with source email was appended. Every decision is order-independent: no two appending decisions share a membership.
conventions.retryBehaviours: ok returns a reading with every field null (state no_balance); rate_limited, timeout, api_error, refused and bad_output return that failure class; throw rejects with a plain Error; hang never settles. A script entry is consumed per call; a message absent from a run's calls is not offered. unread means no reads row.
